paper_title: HeLIOS: The Superfluid Helium Ultralight Dark Matter Detector
notes: Prototype superfluid helium optomechanical UDM detector. Paper presents projected sensitivities (1-hour integration) for both scalar UDM (d_me coupling to electron mass, ScalarElectron) and vector UDM (g_B-L, VectorBL). It is a projection, not an observed limit (no thermal-noise-limited readout achieved yet). The vector plot covers ~3-50 kHz Compton frequency (m ~ 1e-11 to 2e-10 eV) with g_B-L from ~1e-26 to 1e-16. No numerical table of exclusion curve points is given; values must be read from Fig. 1 which is not reproducible from the text, so data_points is empty. Both ScalarElectron and VectorBL are constrained; VectorBL chosen per hint and B-L explicit in text. | selector: figure_vision (sole candidate) | Vision: Right panel: vector B-L coupling g_BL vs vector boson mass [peV]. The shaded green/red region represents projected/achievable HeLIOS limits plus existing bounds (Eot-Wash, LIGO/Virgo). The boundary traced is the lower envelope of the LIGO/Virgo + HeLIOS pressurize bounds, with sharp peaked resonant structures at the mechanical mode frequencies. Mass converted from peV to eV.
